title: Elastic Security Hunt
description: Executes OpenCTI hunts on Elastic Security. OpenCTI dispatches one hunt run per hunt and time window; the connector translates the canonical Sigma rule of the hunt into ES|QL, EQL or Lucene with pySigma (ECS pipelines for Windows, macOS, Kubernetes and Zeek) or runs the native ES|QL, EQL or Lucene query written for Elastic Security, executes it on Elasticsearch over the run window within the run timeout and result limits, and reports the run to OpenCTI. When the hunt matches, the techniques and indicators of the hunt are sighted on the Elastic Security Security Platform and the IOC observables found in the results are sent as observed-data. Raw events never leave Elasticsearch: OpenCTI only receives counts and a hashed, truncated evidence sample. Before you start: an API key whose role holds the read and view_index_metadata index privileges on the hunted indices, no cluster privilege. The least-privilege permissions, the console steps and a copy-ready configuration are at https://docs.opencti.io/latest/usage/hunt-connectors/#elastic-security, and Test connection on the connector page in OpenCTI checks them.
short_description: Runs OpenCTI hunts (Sigma translated to ES|QL, EQL or Lucene, or native queries) on Elastic Security and reports sightings, observed IOCs and redacted evidence.
